msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia carlos-joyeria-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a round blue sapphire ring with a diamond halo in white gold from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold cocktail ring with three stones: a blue cabochon sapphire, a purple square amethyst and a light blue topaz from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a white gold ring with a square brown smoky quartz and a pavé band from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a white gold ring with a round blue sapphire surrounded by a diamond halo from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold ring with three round emeralds and small diamonds from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.

IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold toi-et-moi ring with two hexagonal sapphires framed in diamonds from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «l1» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Lifestyle photo: two stacked thin gold rings, one with an emerald and one with a ruby, on a sage-green velvet box, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia carlos-joyeria-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle photo: a woman's hand wearing a small sapphire halo ring, elegant, close up, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia carlos-joyeria-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of an elegant jewellery shop window with grey velvet necklace busts and rows of rings on dark display stands, no people, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
